title: Nanite-Style WebGPU Rendering in Rust: Meshlets, LOD, and HZB
description: Build a Nanite-style WebGPU renderer in Rust with streamed meshlet pages, projected-error LOD, two-pass HZB occlusion, indirect draws, and GPU skinning.
imageAlt: Thousands of animated Jax rabbit characters rendered in colored WebGPU meshlet LOD bands with a Nanite diagnostics panel.
